story_structure.value: And–But–Therefore (clarity), as a misconception-correction arc (S-11). AND: you type text and the same model answers — two very different answers (L1). BUT: the difference is not luck; it is the prompt, whose three jobs are counted on screen (L2–L3) and performed as a vague-vs-directed pair (L4–L5). THEREFORE: the prompt is steering text — placed against standing Instructions (L6), the folk fix dies (L7), and the close restates the definition (L8). Intended feeling: a small click of control — 'the answer was in my hands before the model wrote a word.'
story_structure.rationale: Declared before drafting in the i1 Narrative Gate (N-04) and re-verified in the locked i3's HS-09 consistency record: structure = misconception-correction arc, chosen because the viewer's existing model ('a prompt is just a question') is the thing being replaced.

prompt_instructions_canon.value: CANON POSITION (Hadi, 2026-10-26): a prompt is a DIRECTION given to the work — and not a single event. As the agent produces the context (continued, compacted), every prompt the user adds is a new direction that re-steers it; across a job the prompts accumulate, and gathered into a chain summary they form the MEGA PROMPT — the accumulated directions. In his words: 'the prompt is not just one sentence, but all the directions that the user tries to re-steer the context in a different direction.'
prompt_instructions_canon.rationale: His ruling replaces the PROVISIONAL library-derived ruling embodied at the rejected text's L6 ('a prompt lives once, in this chat') — that claim is false under his definition, and the redevelopment draft carries no such line. WHAT THIS SETTLES: the canon meaning of the term 'prompt' — direction + accumulation — which is the question Action #27 actually asked; the field therefore closes. WHAT IT DOES NOT SETTLE: the prompt↔Instructions boundary (standing guidance vs given directions). His definition does not rule on it, the old L6's framing of it is superseded together with the rejected text, and the new draft does not depend on the boundary — if a future draft needs it, it reopens as its own question, not as a rider on this field.
prompt_instructions_canon.source: hadi (his definition, 2026-10-26) — supersedes the archer-derived PROVISIONAL ruling (script v3 §0); resolves board ask req-wd02-prompt-canon (Action #27) on its term question
prompt_instructions_canon.record: THE PROPOSED RULING, embodied in the built piece (script v3 §0 + scene record DR-RULING): 'prompt' is not a system part and not a rival term to Instructions — a prompt is the text given in the moment, one call's worth of input, part of the active context; Instructions are the standing guidance stored in the harness that steers every call. It lives in the piece at L6: 'A prompt lives once, in this chat. Instructions are the rules you set once, standing behind every chat.' Status in the script of record: PROVISIONAL — derived by exhaustion search of Hadi's own library (The Language of Agents; We Could Have Had AGI By Now; LLMs Are Not the Agents; canon §3 — full trail in script v3 §0), shipped inside the artifact for Hadi to correct on it under his substantial-artifact rule; the bare gates #27/#28 were withdrawn (sprint plan F-3) and the board's extra_check 'Canon call: prompt is not a canon term' stands pending. If he rules otherwise, L6 is the only line that moves. Record discrepancy, carried not smoothed: the governing ask's context quotes v2-era lines (its L6/L8 are the superseded i2 mechanism/close lines) — the ask predates the unfreeze round; the proposal of record is the built v3 L6 above. | RESOLVED AS STATED 2026-10-26 (JOB WD02-REDEVELOP-1): the owner ruled from his own definition (transcript/redevelopment-draft-2026-10-26.md §1). The term question is closed; the Instructions-boundary sub-point is recorded unsettled in this field's rationale and is no longer load-bearing — the draft that would have depended on it is rejected, and its replacement does not use the boundary.

direction_wording.value: "Direction" in wd-02 is the STRUCTURAL sense, and it is the piece's concept: a prompt HAS a direction — it points the context somewhere — and every later prompt re-steers it. Ruled by Hadi, 2026-10-26, in his own definition of prompt.
direction_wording.rationale: The owner's redevelopment direction defines prompt BY direction: as the context is produced (continued, compacted), prompting is giving new directions, and the intermediate prompts shift the context in a particular direction. The provisional DR-3 restriction — 'direction' in the everyday steering sense only, the direction model never invoked — is superseded: the structural sense is now the teaching content itself. The recorded swap path (L8 'direction' → 'course') is dead with it: swapping the word out would remove the concept the piece teaches.
direction_wording.source: hadi (redevelopment direction, 2026-10-26) — resolves the second flag of board ask req-wd02-prompt-canon
direction_wording.record: The word 'direction' is kept in L7/L8 in the everyday steering sense only (script v3 §6, DR-3 — PROVISIONAL): the direction model (vectors, WS01/DIR series) is never invoked, named or visually echoed in the arc — B7's arrow is a drawn steering arrow on a card. Recorded swap path if Hadi prefers zero overlap: L8 'direction' → 'course' at zero structural cost. The same flag rides in the governing canon ask (req-wd02-prompt-canon) as its second item; no ruling is on record. | RESOLVED 2026-10-26 (JOB WD02-REDEVELOP-1): the owner's own definition makes direction (structural sense) the concept of the piece — see transcript/redevelopment-draft-2026-10-26.md §1. DR-3's provisional restriction and the 'course' swap path are superseded, not merely answered.
